aggregation: Calendar-month totals of daily hotspot detections. All six series share this unit, so they are directly comparable in magnitude; they differ in sensor and scale, which is the point of the comparison. Missing days are excluded and reported as coverage; nothing is interpolated or zero-filled.
coverage_note: observed_ratio below 1.0 means only part of that month was observed, so its monthly total is a lower bound rather than a full-month count.
reference: VIIRS Suomi-NPP (reference scale, not ground truth)
sensor_equivalence: MODIS and VIIRS are different sensors with different resolution and sensitivity. Raw MODIS and raw VIIRS lines are not equivalent measurements.

modis.label: MODIS raw
modis.note: Terra + Aqua hotspot detections, summed over the selected platforms.

viirs.label: VIIRS raw (Suomi-NPP)
viirs.note: Reference sensor. Never reconstructed, and never treated as ground truth.

ratio.label: Ratio correction
ratio.note: One VIIRS/MODIS ratio per district and month, pooled when a month is thin.

quantile_mapping.label: Quantile mapping
quantile_mapping.note: Maps the MODIS distribution onto the VIIRS distribution.

monthly_shrinkage.label: Monthly shrinkage
monthly_shrinkage.note: Monthly ratio pulled toward the district ratio when evidence is thin.

harmonized.label: Harmonized (provisional monthly shrinkage)
harmonized.note: No validated winner exists. Post-2012 values are the provisional monthly-shrinkage estimate; pre-2012 values are gated MODIS-derived VIIRS-equivalent estimates, not VIIRS observations.
